reviews.text: Reasonably large store with a good selection, customer service has always been friendly.
The groomer Milla is extremely skilled and friendly. Clean shop, good selection.

Super lovely customer service today from Linnea. Clean and nice sized store, with really cute toys, clothes and dishes for pets. The cats and the waiter thank you for the delicious and cute food dishes. ❤️🍄🐈🐈‍⬛ I have shopped here and in the Kamppi store many times and every time I have had great customer service and a wide selection of products. Thank you. 🫶🏻
